question: How is immense material wealth contrasted with the value of the Kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
This sets up a comparison of value
inference: Even the accumulation of an ocean filled with jewels is invoked as a measure of lesser value.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form; reading is tentative
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
